name: Hero sections
description: Two opening sections for a landing page: a centred headline over a framed preview, and a split layout with photographs that move with the pointer.

props.name: brand
props.description: The wordmark at the left of the top bar, usually a link home.

props.name: links
props.description: Links in the middle of the top bar. When the section is narrower than 768px they move into a small menu behind a button at the right of the bar; Escape or a press outside closes it.

props.name: signIn
props.description: The action at the right of the top bar.

props.name: title
props.description: The headline. Its words arrive one by one out of a blur.

props.name: preview
props.description: Content for the large frame at the bottom, which rises into place after the text. Give it its own aspect ratio.

props.name: footnote
props.description: A quiet line under the buttons, such as who writes the forecasts.

props.name: images
props.type: { src: string; alt?: string; label?: ReactNode }[]
props.description: Three photographs, back to front. They overlap at small angles and shift with the pointer, the front one most. A label is shown as a chip on the photograph.

props.name: shift
props.description: How far the front photograph moves, in pixels, with the pointer at the edge of the section.
